svc.sub: Services and prices shown at checkout and booking
svc.noCategories: No categories for this business type yet — add one first
svc.homeVisitHelp: Can be booked at the customer's home
svc.priceViaHistory: To change the price use “Prices”: a new price starts on a date and the old one stays for past invoices.
svc.priceRule: Prices are never changed retroactively. A new price starts today or later; past invoices keep their price.

staff.sub: Service providers: the branches they work in and the services they deliver
staff.name: Name

cust.search: Search by name, phone or child's name
cust.name: Name
cust.marketingHelp: Offers are sent only with the customer's consent
cust.addSelfHelp: Turn off for a guardian who only books for children

plan.sub: Your plan, its limits and your customer app links
plan.appLinksHelp: Customers open the link and add it to their home screen — it shows your company's name
plan.changeVia: To change plan, contact the Qassa team

platform.tenantsSub: Subscribed salon companies, plans and links
platform.plansSub: Plans shown on the pricing page and their limits
platform.ownerInviteNote: The owner sets a password and two-step verification. Email invitations are not enabled yet.
platform.domainsHelp: A custom domain is activated after the customer points DNS to us
platform.noCustomDomain: The company's plan does not include a custom domain
platform.ownerPhoneHelp: Login codes are sent here from the platform number. Only changeable here (account security).

book.sub: Book, move to the chair, and send to checkout when done
book.orName: Or a name without a profile
book.noServices: No priced services for this branch yet

pos.customer: Customer (optional) — search by name or phone
pos.empty: Tap a service to add it
pos.creditHelp: The balance is recorded against the customer
pos.splitMismatch: Cash + KNET must equal the total
pos.noDrawer: The drawer is closed — open it to take cash.

inv.waText: Thank you for visiting. Invoice {{n}}, total {{total}}
inv.returnHelp: A return issues a credit note; the original invoice never changes. Cash refunds need an open drawer.

cash.sub: Open with a float and count the drawer at close to find shortages or overages
cash.closedNotice: No open drawer in this branch
cash.countHelp: Count each note and coin. The system totals it and shows the variance, which someone else approves.

wa.sub: Your company's WhatsApp number for login codes and customer messages
wa.noGateway: The platform's WhatsApp gateway is not configured yet — contact the Qassa team
wa.step1: Open WhatsApp on the salon's phone
wa.step2: Settings → Linked devices → Link a device
wa.step3: Point the camera at the code
wa.qrExpires: The code refreshes — press “Connect number” again if it expires
wa.risk: Unofficial WhatsApp link: Meta may ban the number. Use a dedicated salon number and message only customers who agreed.

inv2.adjustHelp: Current stock {{qty}}. Enter a negative or positive difference.
inv2.receiveHelp: Receiving adds stock, updates average cost and proposes a journal entry.
inv2.billHelp: The bill amount must equal the receipt value {{total}}.
inv2.payHelp: Bank transfer only; enter the reference.

mkt.sub: Session packages, coupons and loyalty points
mkt.packageHelp: Package money is a liability, recognised as revenue per session used.
mkt.pointsHelp: Customers earn points on paid invoices
mkt.accountingNote: Points and coupon discounts are posted as discounts for the accountant to review.

com.rule: Commission is a % of net service value and reverses on returns.
com.payHelp: Paid by bank transfer; a journal entry is proposed.

usr.sub: Who can sign in and what they can do
usr.existing: This person already has an account and was added.
usr.manual: No email or WhatsApp available — send this link yourself:

pw.doneSub: Sign in now with your email and password.

xbrl.sub: Annual statements in the XBRL template order, for the accountant to transfer
xbrl.draft: Draft from posted entries — not audited. The accountant and auditor must review before filing.
xbrl.noData: No posted entries in this period
xbrl.cfNote: Cash flows and changes in equity are not generated yet — they need the accountant's classification.
